shortcut_name: lexicographic reduction of the subset metric
evidence: The survivor uses a sequential `dfs(v: int)` with `poss = [0b111] * n`, and the metric can be reduced because it tests colors in increasing order and returns at the first complete assignment.
affordance_in_statement: For each non-empty subset S, the primary source of noise is the transmitter in S with the lowest ID ... The interference generated by the subset S is given by b_k × 3^{|S|-1}.
removal_suggestion: Avoid making the positional dominance implicit in the subset formula; define an objective whose contributions do not make the first valid coloring in ID order optimal. For example, use 2^{|S|-1} instead of 3^{|S|-1}, while retaining the same input and output formats and examples if they remain valid.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: It searches vertices in ID order with forward checking and can stop at the first valid coloring, relying on the metric being equivalent to minimizing the color vector lexicographically.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The lowest-ID primary transmitter and the factor 3^{|S|-1} make the coefficient of b_k equal to 4^{n-k}, so each earlier color dominates all later colors.

common_affordance: The subset objective collapses to lexicographic minimization of the band sequence, allowing a sequential ascending-color DFS to stop at its first satisfying 3-coloring.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It explicitly tries all 3^n colorings, which is infeasible at n = 40.
Its approach relies on exhaustive 3-coloring/product-style exploration and times out on the maximum-sized instances.
Its component-processing implementation terminates with a runtime error before producing a valid result.

recommended_edit: Change the subset multiplier from 3^{|S|-1} to 2^{|S|-1}. This removes the positional-dominance property, so the first valid coloring found by ascending DFS is no longer guaranteed to minimize the metric.
regression_risk: Changing the multiplier could make an exhaustive solver pass only if the altered objective permits an easier shortcut; protect against this by retaining adversarial 3-colorability instances near n = 40.
